# A Canadian book whose only US dollars owed are the ones a card paid a bill with.
#
# BILL-USD-1 bills 1,000.00 USD and is posted on 2026-08-01 at 1.38
# (usd_at_the_rates_the_statement_lines_records_were_posted_at.yaml), which
# opens the bill's cost basis on its A/P posting split: 1,000.00 USD owed at
# 1,380.00 CAD. It is paid on 2026-08-05 on Liabilities:Credit Card USD, so the
# dollars are still owed, now to the card issuer. The bill's cost basis is what
# those dollars owed cost, and it is the only US dollar cost basis the book keeps.
#
# What this fixture produces: Liabilities:Credit Card USD owing 1,000.00 USD and
# one US dollar cost basis, BILL-USD-1's, at 1,000.00. Imported with
# `--include-business-objects` and the rates file above.
#
# Verified by
# tests/scenario/test_pending_counts_the_cost_basis_an_invoice_or_a_bill_opened.py.
2026-07-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-07-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-07-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-07-01 open Assets:Chequing
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-07-01 open Liabilities
	type: "Liability"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-07-01 open Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD
	type: "Payable"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-07-01 open Liabilities:Credit Card USD
	type: "Credit Card"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-07-01 open Expenses
	type: "Expense"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-07-01 open Expenses:Supplies
	type: "Expense"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
vendor "V-USD"
	name: "Example Supplier Inc"
	currency: USD
bill "BILL-USD-1"
	vendor_id: "V-USD"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-08-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-08-01
		description: "Parts"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 1
		price: 1000
		taxable: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-08-01
		due: 2026-08-31
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
		memo: "Bill BILL-USD-1"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-08-05
		amount: 1000
		account: "Liabilities:Credit Card USD"
		memo: "Paid on the company card"
